name: chat-composer
title: ChatComposer
description: Chat input: autosizing textarea, Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line, attachments (pick, paste or drag-and-drop files; `accept`, `maxSize` and `maxFiles` validation with messages in an alert; chips with image thumbnails, file-type icons, size, upload progress, error + Retry and Remove), a model-picker slot (e.g. a compact ModelPicker), a character counter near the limit, a disabled state, and a Stop button while a reply streams.
author: gntik-ai
